card.name: Inside names of people and places
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split-up proper name, such as a person's given name or surname or a place name, in general web text. It fires on the fragment right after the start of the name, before the rest of it follows.

modes.label: Surnames and given names
modes.description: A piece partway through a person's name that is cut into parts, often non-English.
modes.example: Dev Niyogi, Krishna K.<< Os>>uri, D. Pradhan.

modes.label: Place names
modes.description: A piece at the start of an Indian or other place name.

card.plain: It marks a spot partway through an unusual proper name, where the rest of the name is still to come.
